title: Quickly Flambe Turkish Fish Borek
description: A show-off Turkish dish featuring stale bread and flambe, this pescatarian-friendly borek is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the stale bread into small cubes and toast until lightly browned.
In a pan, heat the olive oil and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the fish fillets to the pan and cook until opaque and flaky.
In a bowl, mix together the toasted bread, cooked fish, feta cheese, parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Spoon the mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and shape into a borek form.
Drizzle the rum over the borek and ignite to flambe.
Once the flames have died down, bake the borek in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the borek from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
